name: Jezero crater
why_it_matters: Perseverance landing site. Deltaic sediments plus nearby highlands. Known ground truth for a first city-planning demo.

name: Gale crater
why_it_matters: Curiosity site. Long REMS weather record. Useful for thermal and dust baselines.

name: Oxia Planum
why_it_matters: ExoMars Rosalind Franklin landing region. Clay-bearing and relatively low.

name: Mawrth Vallis
why_it_matters: Phyllosilicate-rich and often shortlisted for landing. Contrast to ice-rich mid-latitudes.

name: Arcadia Planitia
why_it_matters: SWIM-favoured mid-latitude ice. Classic ISRU water target.

name: Deuteronilus Mensae
why_it_matters: Lobate debris aprons and buried ice. Mid-latitude glacier-like forms.

name: Phlegra Montes
why_it_matters: SWIM-style mid-latitude ice province with relief for shelter.

name: Utopia Planitia
why_it_matters: Vast northern basin. Ice plus flat ground. InSight landed further south in Elysium.

name: Hellas Planitia
why_it_matters: Deepest large basin. Highest surface pressure. Cold trap and dust risk.

name: Isidis Planitia
why_it_matters: Next to Jezero. Low, broad, and a plausible regional logistics hub.

name: Elysium Planitia
why_it_matters: InSight landing region. Relatively flat volcanic plains.

name: Acidalia Planitia
why_it_matters: Northern lowlands. Ice-relevant. Often discussed for settlement belts.

name: Vastitas Borealis
why_it_matters: High-latitude ice certainty, poor solar winter, hard landing.

name: South polar layered deposits
why_it_matters: Near-surface ice and CO2. Extreme seasonality. Not a first-city site.

name: Olympus Mons
why_it_matters: Landmark and comms high ground. Terrible first habitat: thin air, hard EDL.

name: Valles Marineris
why_it_matters: Shelter and layered access vs access cost and slope.

name: Pavonis Mons lava tubes
why_it_matters: Tharsis volcano flank. Published lava-tube candidates. Radiation shelter hypothesis.

name: Chryse Planitia
why_it_matters: Viking 1. Outflow-channel mouth, low, historically landed.

name: Meridiani Planum
why_it_matters: Opportunity site. Hematite, relatively flat, equatorial solar.

name: Gusev crater
why_it_matters: Spirit site. Crater plus volcanic plains. Another ground-truth pin.
